title: Remote Engineering Control V1 activation readiness
requested_outcome: Implement the missing no-courier activation behaviours on top of exact base 2426923baf2f419a08aadfb4cde156e364ee591a: add a long-lived bounded loop that polls the existing GitHub inbox, advances the existing deterministic Dispatcher (not a second lifecycle), and publishes a read-only GitHub-visible status projection to a dedicated status branch separate from the inbox. Preserve all existing authority boundaries, protected paths, owner gates, sandboxed checks, credential isolation and repository-only scope. Use branch chatgpt/remote-engineering-control-v1-activation-readiness-2026-09-24 as a reference implementation only; independently implement and verify the behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: a long-lived run mode repeatedly polls the bounded owner inbox and advances the existing Dispatcher
GitHub-visible status is published as a projection of existing lifecycle and receipt records, never as authority
the status ref is separate from the owner inbox ref and cannot overwrite inbox requests
remote and ref names remain bounded and cannot become arbitrary URLs or shell execution
restart and re-poll remain idempotent and do not duplicate objectives, attempts, reviews or integrations
owner gates, protected paths, deployment, secrets and business writes remain impossible through remote ingress
